concept.title: Which file to send
concept.shortdesc: Send the copy you saved yourself, and not the other files beside your tree, so your family gets the tree you meant to share.

conbody.p: To share your tree, send a copy that you saved with . shows how to make one.

Do not send the files that keeps beside your tree. The backup is an old version of your tree. The file written in GEDCOM 7 is a second copy of it. To send everything in your workspace, send a GEDZIP file. Sending the wrong one sends an old tree or a second copy.
A saved copy stays as it was when you made it. Make a new one before you send, if you have added anything since. says what each file is.
